task_workloads: Task builds and model benchmarks were sequential during measurement. No task build ran during timed inference.
external_workload: An existing Virtualization VM remained active; pre-run snapshots reported 15.7 to 27.4 percent CPU for that process. User applications were left running.

memory: Reports record maximum process RSS, not complete GPU/unified-memory residency.
source_provenance: commit identifies the benchmark harness checkout; worker_source_commit identifies the saved worker source. The original CPU parity worker predates profiling.
curation: Only machine-specific paths and JSON whitespace were changed when retaining evidence. Model, fixture, worker, runtime, transcript, and timing values are preserved.
